tools.name: next_mercury_retrograde
tools.description: Returns the next Mercury retrograde after a date (or the one in progress, until it stations direct) with its sign, pre-shadow, station retrograde, cazimi, station direct and post-shadow end. tools.name: next_mercury_cazimi
tools.description: Returns the next Mercury cazimi (exact Sun–Mercury conjunction during a retrograde) after a date, with the UTC minute, the degree and 17′ window when known, and the previous cazimi. tools.name: mercury_retrograde_dates
tools.description: Lists every Mercury retrograde period that falls in or overlaps a year from 2025 to 2030, with sign, pre-shadow, station retrograde, cazimi, station direct and post-shadow end. Times are UTC, to the minute, from the ephemeris (JPL DE421, 2025–2030). This is astronomical timing, not a horoscope.
